title: deep-review Q1: repair the reviewer re-verification gate (test:since base-ref, fast tier per-ticket, calibration allowlisted)
description: Deep-review confirmed finding (2026-07-02), the most urgent item of the roadmap: the review gate reports green having run ZERO tests on every ticket. (a) npm run test:changed diffs against HEAD, but at review time the developer diff is already committed, so vitest selects zero specs and exits 0 (No test files found + passWithNoTests) - the green-must-reproduce-as-green check is a silent false positive, and the reviewer cannot use the correct form because npx is not in its Bash allowlist. (b) The --changed import graph is blind to markdown (agents/skills/commands/CLAUDE.md) - parity sensors read files via readFileSync with no import edge, so an md-only ticket (the exact shape of TASK-076/077/078) runs zero sensors. (c) reviewer.md declares the calibration check HIGH/BLOCK but invokes it as node bin/check-calibration.js, outside the allowlist - hard denial exactly on the mandatory blocker.
acceptance_criteria: A test:since npm script exists (vitest run --changed=<base-ref> --config vitest.config.all.js) accepting a base ref and runnable via the allowlisted npm run form; agents/reviewer.md (+ parity copy) instructs running it with the ticket diff range base it already receives.
The per-ticket gate adds npm test (fast tier, ~2s, contains all fs-read sensors) in CLAUDE.md, developer.md, and reviewer.md - NOT via forceRerunTriggers (would drag the slow e2e tier).
Calibration is runnable by the reviewer: documented as npm run check:calibration -- <args> (allowlisted form) and reviewer.md requires its output in the Verification block.
A doc-lock spec pins the gate prose (test:since + fast-tier requirement in the three docs) so the contract cannot rot silently; red-green proven.
Full npm run test:all green (this ticket touches test infrastructure).

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Closed on green re-review after ONE REQUEST-CHANGES loop (auto_close grant, 2026-07-02). Round 1 (e84d658 + c7e908e): test:since script, fast tier added to the per-ticket gate in CLAUDE.md/developer.md/reviewer.md (+parity), calibration re-documented in the allowlisted npm run check:calibration form, doc-lock spec. Reviewer BLOCK caught HIGH-1 by DOGFOODING the gate on its own review base: test:since silently dropped all-digit refs (cac coerces to number; vitest guard requires string) and invalid refs exited 0 with zero specs — the exact silent false positive the ticket exists to kill; plus MEDIUM-1 non-discriminating doc-lock anchors. Round 2 (5924895 + 8dcb532): validating wrapper scripts/test-since.mjs (git rev-parse --verify <ref>^{commit}, loud exit 1/2, forwards <full-sha>~0 so numeric coercion can never re-fire), zero-specs-is-gate-FAILURE rule in all three docs, unit + e2e regression locks (injected-exec + real spawn), section-scoped doc-lock anchors with precise red-green plant (1-of-9 failed on the scoped revert). Cold re-verify PASS 0H/0M/1L: both demonstrations reproduced, flag-smuggling probe (--all) safe (spawnSync array form, no shell on the rev-parse leg; forwarded ref is git-emitted sha, never user input), test:all 995/4 green. LOW advisory (non-blocking, comment-only): the vitest spawn leg uses shell:true — extra args with spaces/metachars would re-split on Windows; local-operator surface, fix opportunistically. SEVENTH RC-HIGH of the framework era, again in an unspecced path — caught because the reviewer exercised the artifact with realistic input.
